A Letter For You

Written from the heart, word by word

My dearest Nikku,

I wanted to give you something that says more than a text ever could. So I built this little world, just for you. Everything beautiful here exists because of you — because everything good in my life has you somewhere behind it.

Honestly, I never knew one person could make life feel so light. With you, even a hard day feels okay, and a good day becomes a memory I keep forever.

The most beautiful thing about you isn't just how you look (though, yes, you're stunning). It's who you are. You listen as if every word matters. Your laughter makes everything around you softer. And when you're beside me, I don't need anything else.

Thank you for your patience when I got things wrong. For understanding what I never said out loud. For the care you never announce. And for the courage you lend me when I can't believe in myself.

I'm not perfect, Nikku. Sometimes I slip, sometimes I go quiet, sometimes I forget to tell you how much you matter. But one thing will always be true — you are my choice. Every day, every time.

I don't want to make grand promises. Only these: I'll listen when you speak, cheer for every dream you have, and treat your smile as my greatest responsibility. Your hand will never slip from mine.

And if you ever feel you're not enough — remember, you are my favourite person in this whole world, and "enough" is far too small a word for you.

Your birthday is on the 21st of December, and I couldn't wait until then to tell you how special you are. So consider this your very first birthday wish — an early one, straight from my heart. 🎂 Happy early birthday, my love!

That's all I wanted to say. There's so much more waiting for you below — keep scrolling, and do make it all the way to the end. 💗

A Little Verse

For you, and only you

You walked in, and the weather changed,
the clocks the same, but time rearranged.
Once there were roads, now there's a place,
once there was "me", now "us" has a face.

Your laugh holds the morning's gold,
your silence, a story still untold.
Should anyone ask where home might be,
I'll say: wherever you are with me.
